text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Kuwait's press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Kuwait signs judicial cooperation pact with Morocco.
- Kuwait Stock Exchange index rises 34.4 points on Sunday, volume falls.
- Central Bank launches study to improve local banks' administration systems.
- Chamber of Commerce and Industry to hold seminar on attracting local workforce to private sector jobs.

- Russian envoy says Moscow to launch an initiative to solve the issue of the Kuwaiti prisoners of war. Kuwait says some 600 Kuwaitis are still held in Iraq since its 1990-91 occupation of the Gulf state. Iraq denies holding any Kuwaitis.
